unlockPath.basis: The device is currently booting an alternate verified-boot root while locked. Installing that alternate OS required the Pixel bootloader unlock path and subsequent relock; the official GrapheneOS installer documents both operations and the yellow alternate-key state.

scope: Confirms the observed locked alternate-OS boot state and that this handset has used the unlock/relock path. It does not authorize unlocking, flashing, erasing data, or changing the current OEM unlocking setting.
